subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw accept sourceActor as the generic additive plugin SDK and memory recall attribution contract in this stack?
rationale: The patch is plausibly correct, but it promotes new public context fields and memory supplement parameters that become plugin-facing API expectations; automation should not decide that product/API direction alone.

options.title: Accept after stack lands
options.body: Merge the prerequisite PRs first, rebase this branch, and treat sourceActor as the current additive attribution plumbing contract while durable provenance remains separate.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep sourceActor internal or memory-core-only until maintainers settle the public plugin API shape.

options.title: Defer to provenance model
options.body: Close or pause this PR and handle attribution through the broader durable provenance work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42647.

recommendation.title: Accept after stack lands
recommendation.body: Merge the prerequisite PRs first, rebase this branch, and treat sourceActor as the current additive attribution plumbing contract while durable provenance remains separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The most central decision is the memory supplement and memory-core contract, which traces to vincentkoc's memory corpus bridge work.
